info.title: conduit
info.description: A .NET global tool that mirrors agent skills from GitHub or local directories into your agent folders, driven by a conduit.json manifest.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: conduit — sync agent skills from remote sources (e.g. GitHub) into local agent directories.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Path to the conduit manifest. When omitted, the file is discovered via $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Zakira.Conduit/conduit.json (and standard fallbacks).

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Output verbosity. One of: q[uiet], m[inimal], n[ormal], d[etailed], diag[nostic]. Default: normal. [default: normal]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Shortcut for --verbosity detailed. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Shortcut for --verbosity quiet. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: text (human-friendly, default) or json (machine-readable, stdout-only). [default: Text]

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Synchronize manifest entries into their target directories.

options.name: --entry
options.description: Sync only the named entry (repeatable). When omitted, all enabled entries are synced.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Fetch sources and report what would change, without writing to any target. [default: False]

options.name: --stop-on-first-error
options.description: Abort the run on the first failing entry instead of attempting subsequent ones. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Ignore the cached state file and re-fetch/re-mirror every entry, even if it appears up-to-date. [default: False]

options.name: --parallel
options.description: Maximum number of entries to sync in parallel. Default: 4. Use 1 to force sequential execution. [default: 4]

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate the manifest without performing any IO against remote sources.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create a starter conduit.json manifest. Writes to --manifest, or to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Zakira.Conduit/conduit.json.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing manifest if one is present at the target path. [default: False]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Walk through prompts to populate the first entry instead of writing the placeholder template. [default: False]

commands.name: pin
commands.description: Resolve every github entry's tracked branch to its current SHA and write the result into the manifest's 'commit' field.

options.name: --entry
options.description: Limit the operation to the named entry (repeatable).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report what would change, without rewriting the manifest. [default: False]

commands.name: update
commands.description: Alias of 'pin'. Refresh each pinned entry to the latest SHA on its tracked branch.

options.name: --entry
options.description: Limit the operation to the named entry (repeatable).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report what would change, without rewriting the manifest. [default: False]

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Run an initial sync, then re-sync whenever the manifest changes on disk. Ctrl+C to stop.

options.name: --debounce
options.description: Time in milliseconds to coalesce burst writes to the manifest. Default: 250. [default: 250]

options.name: --parallel
options.description: Maximum number of entries to sync in parallel for each re-run. Default: 4. [default: 4]

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show what each manifest entry was last synced to (no network IO).
